text: All local definitions shall be private unless explicitly exported by `export type Name`, `export $name`, or `export @name`. Each export shall name a current-module definition; unresolved function declarations, duplicate exports, wrong-kind selections, and imported entity re-exports shall be rejected. An exported alias may refer to an imported type while retaining its identity.
